_model_description_: Task-continual learning (CIFAR-100 or Tiny ImageNet, 5 classes/task). Independent training gates tasks by NC4; only accepted tasks enter joint/continual training.
_comment_data_: Data paths. For tiny_imagenet, set data_path to the folder containing train/, val/, test/ (note: data is nested one level under tiny-imagenet-200 (1)).
_comment_agent_desc_: 'bp': standard SGD  |  'cbp': Continual Backprop  |  'ewc': Elastic Weight Consolidation
_comment_reset_: ========== Network resetting (currently unused in task-continual setup) ==========
